objective.value: Can you review our treasury and financing position at December month-end, including the year-to-date movements? Interest expense is up, we have a USD loan and a derivative hedge, FX moved a lot, and the cash flow statement does not look right. I have attached the debt schedule, lender statements, FX report, derivative valuation, hedge documentation, bank activity, trial balance and cash flow support.
